blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution panel in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Friday called out one of her lawyers for allegedly going in circles while questioning a Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) witness about the vice president’s tax records. At the resumption of the trial, prosecution counsel Erwin Matib questioned whether defense lawyer Kristine Ferrer was conducting a tutorial on how to file BIR Form 1701, the annual income tax return filed by Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio. Matib made the remark after Ferrer asked lawyer Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez, chief of staff of BIR Commissioner Charlito Mendoza, about […]...
